status_summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act (H.R. 6644, Public Law 119-101) became law on 2026-07-11 without the President's signature. A CRS summary describes no provision preempting local zoning: it relies on nonbinding HUD zoning frameworks (Section 107), competitive planning and innovation grants (Sections 207 and 208, the latter authorized at $200 million a year), and from FY2029 a 10 percent CDBG reduction for communities with below-median housing growth (Section 213), which adds federal fiscal pressure on local land use. Executive Order 14394 (published 2026-03-18) directed HUD to issue voluntary best practices for state and local governments, including by-right single-family development, without preempting local authority. HUD withdrew a 2016 joint statement on land use law and the Fair Housing Act in a notice published 2026-07-17.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14394 was published, directing HUD to issue voluntary state and local best practices on housing regulation, including by-right single-family development.
